messages:
Priya (IC): quick q i'm leaving for parental leave mid-August and want to do a midyear rollover from an old employer plan into our 401(k) and also bump my deferral for the last two paychecks. is that doable?

Iris (People Ops): two separate flows. rollovers go to the custodian and need trustee paperwork; payroll deferrals must hit payroll file by the cutoff. both are possible but handled independently.

Sam (Payroll): payroll constraints: we can increase your % for future paychecks if you submit the portal change by 2026-07-20 cutoff for 8/1 effective. we cannot withhold extra for prior pay periods. for the "bump" idea, do the change early so the last paycheck(s) before leave have higher deferrals.

Jordan (Benefits Admin): rollover: you'll need a direct trustee-to-trustee transfer or a check made payable to the plan custodian. we require the rollover form + proof of prior plan balance. processing time is ~10 business days after we receive completed docs. link: https://benefits.redwood.example/rollover-form.pdf

Priya (IC): if i do the rollover and it posts while i'm on unpaid leave, will that affect employer match or vesting?

Jordan (Benefits Admin): match only applies to payroll deferrals. Rollover amounts are separate and don't trigger match. vesting continues per schedule; approved unpaid leave counts as service for our plan's vesting rules (confirm on the leave approval).

Sam (Payroll): note on catch-up contributions: if you're 50+, catch-up must be indicated on the payroll election prior to withholding. trustee rollovers don't count as catch-up deferrals.

Priya (IC): ok, sounds like i should: 1) submit portal deferral change before cutoff, 2) start rollover paperwork now to hit custodian before leave. anything else?

Iris (People Ops): plus: if you want employer to consider any discretionary contribution during leave, submit an ask with manager approval; that's an exception and leadership must approve. i'll DM you templates and the cutoff calendar.

Benefits Bot: rollover packet (rp_202607) sent to Priya.

Priya (IC): thanks everyone  i'll start the forms today.
